title.zh: 在东达沃省Lupon市镇Macangao设立国立农业中学，名称为Macangao农业职业中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing For the Establishment of A National Agricultural High School in Macangao, Municipality of Lupon, Province of Davao Oriental, To Be Known As the Macangao Agricultural Vocational High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing For the Establishment of A National Agricultural High School in Macangao, Municipality of Lupon, Province of Davao Oriental, To Be Known As the Macangao Agricultural Vocational High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8322_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established, under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national agricultural high school in Macangao, Municipality of Lupon, Province of Davao Oriental, to be known as the Macangao Agricultural Vocational High School.
The school shall, in addition to the regular secondary school curricula, offer agricultural, technical and other vocational subjects.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
